title: P3.1M in smuggled cigarettes seized, 3 busted in Negros Oriental

blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY — Police intercepted some P3.1 million worth of suspected smuggled cigarettes and arrested three men during a joint anti-smuggling operation in Barangay Nagbo-alao, Basay town, Negros Oriental, on Monday morning. The Police Regional Office Negros Island Region (PRO NIR) identified the suspects as “Lom,” 25, the truck driver; and passengers “Joe,” 41, and “Ben,” 40. All three are residents of Barangay Pook in Hinoba-an, Negros Occidental.
